scoring_justification: Recompute interaction energy decrease from raw CSVs and structural analysis of XYZ; T1 is fully feasible.

outputs.description: Interaction energy (vdW+electrostatic) between the SWNT and resin molecule as a function of time for the filling simulation.
Interaction energy (vdW+electrostatic) between the SWNT and resin molecule as a function of time for the wrapping simulation.

schema.description: Two-frame extended XYZ file; first frame: filling final configuration, second frame: wrapping final configuration. Atom symbols and coordinates in angstroms, with optional extra columns ignored.

outputs.description: Final atomic configurations of both simulations showing the resin inside the nanotube (filling) and wrapped around it (wrapping).

output_contract.notes: The checker will read the two CSV files and compute the decrease in interaction energy (average of initial 2 ps minus average of last 2 ps) and verify the decrease meets a required threshold. The XYZ file will be checked for structural evidence: in the filling frame the resin centre of mass must be inside the nanotube cylinder; in the wrapping frame the resin must be close to the nanotube surface with evidence of wrapping.
